spark_open.description: The creature is a four-legged, wolf-shaped animal shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background. Its head, neck, torso, hind legs and tail are covered in thick, shaggy fur in shades of gray, brown and cream like a gray wolf, while its back, shoulders and hips are covered by a dark, glossy, bluish-black bumpy carapace with raised nodules and barnacle-like bumps. Its two hind legs end in typical wolf paws with claws, while its two front legs are furry to the lower joint and then terminate in large, dark, spotted crab-like claws with pincers that rest on the ground. It has a long, bushy, fur-covered tail hanging down at the rear.

four legs; the two hind legs are fully fur-covered wolf legs with visible joints, the two front legs are thickly furred on the upper portion and become smooth, dark, jointed crab-like limbs on the lower portion
